notes: Processed 50 groups from parts 06-10 into 54 rows. Merged groups: 'whitehawk leads 560 million' and 'ballys' are the same Bally's Corporation $560M WhiteHawk-led facility and were emitted as one row under group_key 'ballys' with both candidate ids. Round-ups expanded: 'funding cools' (ascendants.in weekly US round-up) produced five rows (Modal Labs Series D, Icon Series D, Soufflé Therapeutics Series B, Estuary Biotherapeutics Series A plus its previously undisclosed $10M seed); 'gmi cloud' produced two rows (the $223M Series B equity and the $445M credit facility that make up the $668M headline). Round-up rows other than Modal Labs carry the round-up article date (2026-10-17) because the individual announcement dates were not in the text; the real dates fall in the Oct 10-16 window. Lookups used: 9 of 25 (6 WebSearch + 3 WebFetch): Oratomic (thin text; the $775M headline is cumulative funding, the actual round is a $475M Series B per dealroom.co and The Quantum Insider, evidence spans quoted from those fetched pages), GMI Cloud (403; amounts/investors/HQ quoted from the pulse2.com article), Modal Labs (announcement date 2026-10-14), Harvey (announcement date confirmed 2026-09-09; one secondary source calls it Series F but it is not confirmed so round_type stays Venture - Unspecified), Eka Robotics (HQ Cambridge MA, a16z lists the round as 2026-10-20), Angle Health (HQ San Francisco, announced 2026-09-18). Angle Health amount_usd uses the $600M headline, which is a $200M Series C primary plus a $400M tender offer. EUR conversions use a rough 1.17 rate, AUD 0.65. 1Komma5Grad never discloses the round size (only the $1.35B valuation) so amount is null. ID Finance's EUR545M is a mixed debt and equity package with no split disclosed, recorded as round_type Other. Groups not resolvable as a funding round (prepay bonds, philanthropy, contract awards, scholarships, earnings, DeFi launch capital, Africa aggregate stats) are kept with exclude_reason not-funding; public-company debt refinancings carry public-company.
